lines: #You're tired. I *know.*
Everybody is *tired.*
The people who win are tired *too.*
Tired of the alarm. Tired of the *bills.*
Tired of trying and not seeing *results.*
#They just stopped using it as an *excuse.*
Tired is not a reason to *quit.*
It's a reason to go a little *slower.*
Do the short workout. Read *two* pages. Make one call.
#A tired rep still *counts.*
Twenty minutes instead of an *hour.*
Half the plan is still better than *zero.*
In fact, it counts *more.*
Because anyone can show up when they feel *great.*
Showing up tired is what builds *character.*
#This is where you *separate* from everyone else.
Not on the good days. On the *hard* ones.
Nobody remembers who felt good on the easy *days.*
They remember who *showed up.*
Be the one who shows *up.*
So don't wait until you feel *rested.*
Do it tired. Do it *slow.*
#But do it *today.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
